image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a scoop of ice cream featuring two distinct flavors swirled together: a purple/blueberry hue and a creamy vanilla/yellow hue. The texture appears dense and slightly icy, with visible crystalline structures and air pockets. The surface is glossy, indicating slight melting or high fat content. The background is out of focus, suggesting a shallow depth of field, likely inside a container or bowl.
